description: This file defines a protocol `SimpleFileWatcherOwner` with a property `watcher` of type `SimpleFileWatcher`, and provides default implementations of `start()` and `stop()` methods within an extension, facilitating control over a file watcher.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file watcher associated with the owner.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the file watcher associated with the owner.
